items.subject: Request for class notes
items.scenario: You are a student who missed a recent class. You want to ask your classmate, Jessica, for her notes and any important details from the class.
goals: Explain why you missed the class.
Ask for her notes and explain why you need them.
Suggest what you could do for her in return.
